name: pancake_diagnose_incident
description: One-call unified troubleshooting for any Pancake conversation/comment/order. Returns the v2 pipeline stage diagnosis (firstBrokenStage across Auto Pilot, Outreach R0-R2/Z1, Create Order) PLUS full conversation messages, Chatbot 2.0 decisions (with reason_codes), and bot_audit_logs. Read-only.

target.description: Any target reference: Pancake URL (https://pancake.vn/...?c_id=...), Pancake conversation ID (PAGEID_PSID, POSTID_COMMENTID, pzl_u_...), local UUID, message ID (m_...), or Admin Order ID

orderId.description: VietLicense Admin Order ID or local order push UUID

providerRead.description: Pancake GET mode during incident evaluation (default: auto)

includeMessages.description: Include conversation messages, audit logs, and Chatbot 2.0 decisions (default: true)

includeProviderMessages.description: Also fetch raw messages/attachments directly from Pancake API (default: auto when local DB has no messages)

messageLimit.description: Number of recent messages to return (default: 30, max: 150)

redactIdentifiers.description: Redact operational identifiers for external sharing (default: false)
